statement.en: This level is set in Toronto, in Ontario. Discover Canada calls Toronto the largest city in the country and its main financial centre. Many people there work in service or manufacturing industries, and those industries make a large part of Canada's exports.
statement.fr: Ce niveau se déroule à Toronto, en Ontario. Discover Canada présente Toronto comme la plus grande ville du pays et son principal centre financier. Beaucoup de gens y travaillent dans les services ou la fabrication, et ces industries produisent une grande part des exportations du Canada.

source.quote: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre. Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports.

verification.evidence: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre. Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada’s exports.

blurb.en: Public transit is usually run by the local government of a city or town. The local government also looks after streets and roads, garbage and snow removal, firefighting, ambulances and recreation centres.
blurb.fr: Le transport en commun relève habituellement de la municipalité. Elle s'occupe aussi des rues et des routes, de l'enlèvement des ordures et de la neige, de la lutte contre les incendies, des ambulances et des centres de loisirs.

source.quote: Municipalities are normally responsible for urban or regional planning, streets and roads, sanitation (such as garbage removal), snow removal, firefighting, ambulance and other emergency services, recreation facilities, public transit and some local health and social services.

verification.evidence: Local or municipal government plays an important role in the lives of our citizens. Municipal governments usually have a council that passes laws called “by-laws” that affect only the local community. The council usually includes a mayor (or a reeve) and councillors or aldermen. Municipalities are normally responsible for urban or regional planning, streets and roads, sanitation (such as garbage removal), snow removal, firefighting, ambulance and other emergency services, recreation facilities, public transit and some local health and social services.

blurb.en: This is the CN Tower. Toronto is the largest city in Canada. The city is also the country's main centre for banks and finance.
blurb.fr: Voici la Tour CN. Toronto est la plus grande ville du Canada. La ville est aussi le principal centre bancaire et financier du pays.

source.quote: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre.

verification.evidence: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country’s main financial centre.

blurb.en: This is Nathan Phillips Square. Most people in Canada live in cities and towns close to the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River. That part of the country is southern Ontario and southern Quebec.
blurb.fr: Voici la place Nathan-Phillips. La plupart des gens au Canada vivent dans des villes et des villages proches des Grands Lacs et du fleuve Saint-Laurent. Cette partie du pays, c'est le sud de l'Ontario et le sud du Québec.

source.quote: More than half the people in Canada live in cities and towns near the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River in southern Quebec and Ontario

verification.evidence: More than half the people in Canada live in cities and towns near the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River in southern Quebec and Ontario, known as Central Canada and the industrial and manufacturing heartland. Southern Ontario and Quebec have cold winters and warm humid summers.
